Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: Ignored the Planner’s instruction to open credible sources and extract facts, instead relying on search-result snippets. By not clicking into authoritative pages (e.g., Wikipedia, Britannica, IMDb) to confirm David Lynch’s birthplace, the agent propagated conflicting SERP snippets (Sandpoint vs. Missoula) and failed to resolve the answer (correctly Missoula, Montana), leading to an incorrect/unstable solution path.
